forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: A cycle between modules makes them one indivisible unit: neither can be understood, tested or moved without the other.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: An import that does not resolve is either a typo or a module that was moved without updating its importers.

forbidden.name: no-test-in-prod
forbidden.comment: Production code must not depend on test code.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep
forbidden.comment: Production code must not depend on a devDependency: it is absent from the shipped bundle.

forbidden.name: core-is-self-contained
forbidden.comment: core/ holds technical primitives with no business meaning: it sits at the far left of the chain and imports no other layer.

forbidden.name: core-has-no-packages
forbidden.comment: core/ is framework-agnostic. The single carve-out is core/react/, covered by core-react-only-react.

forbidden.name: core-react-only-react
forbidden.comment: core/react/ adapts core primitives to React (useObservable). react is the only package it may know about — not react-native, not expo.

forbidden.name: domain-only-to-core
forbidden.comment: domain/ holds business logic and the ports it needs. It may only import core/.

forbidden.name: domain-has-no-framework
forbidden.comment: domain/ must not import any package at all — react, expo and react-native-ble-plx included.

forbidden.name: infrastructure-not-upward
forbidden.comment: infrastructure/ implements domain ports. It may import core/ and domain/, nothing to their right.

forbidden.name: composition-not-upward
forbidden.comment: composition/ is the single place binding concrete implementations to domain ports. It knows nothing of the UI.

forbidden.name: design-system-is-independent
forbidden.comment: design-system/ knows tokens and generic components. It must stay ignorant of the business.

forbidden.name: components-not-upward
forbidden.comment: components/ renders domain objects with design-system primitives. It never reaches a screen, a route or an implementation.

forbidden.name: screens-not-to-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: screens/ obtains its dependencies from the composition root, never from a concrete implementation.

forbidden.name: app-is-routes-only
forbidden.comment: app/ holds expo-router routes: a route re-exports a screen and wires providers, it contains no logic.

forbidden.name: ble-plx-only-in-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: react-native-ble-plx is a transport detail. It survives in infrastructure/ble/ and in composition/connection/ (temporary tenant) only.

forbidden.name: no-deep-design-system-import
forbidden.comment: Outside design-system/, import the barrel. Inside it, always import concrete files — the barrel would close a cycle.
